# Cult Pens

> > The world's widest online retailer of premium writing instruments, offering 24,000+ pens, pencils, markers, and luxury stationery from global brands.

Cult Pens is a specialist pen and stationery retailer featuring an extensive catalog of writing instruments from leading international manufacturers including German brands (LAMY, Faber-Castell, Kaweco, Pelikan), Japanese makers (Pilot, Platinum, Sailor, Pentel), Italian luxury (Visconti), and Swiss premium brands (Caran d'Ache, Montblanc). The site serves pen enthusiasts, artists, and professionals seeking high-quality writing instruments and art supplies.

## Key Topics

- Fountain pens
- Luxury writing instruments
- Ballpoint pens
- Mechanical pencils
- Art markers (Copic, POSCA)
- LAMY
- Montblanc

## Premium Luxury Brands

- [Montblanc - Luxury Fountain Pens, Rollerballs and Ballpoints](https://cultpens.com/collections/montblanc): Montblanc luxury pens including Meisterstück collection
- [Visconti - Luxurious Pens with Italian Design Flair](https://cultpens.com/collections/visconti): Visconti Italian luxury fountain pens and limited editions
- [Pelikan Fine Writing, with the highly respected Souverän](https://cultpens.com/collections/pelikan): Pelikan luxury writing instruments and Souverän fountain pens
- [Caran d'Ache - Swiss Pens, Pencils And Art Materials](https://cultpens.com/collections/caran-dache): Caran d'Ache Swiss pens and Prismalo colored pencils collection

## German & European Writing Instruments

- [Faber-Castell - German Design and Engineering at its Best](https://cultpens.com/collections/faber-castell): Faber-Castell pens, pencils, and Souverän fountain pens
- [LAMY - fountain pens, ballpoint pens and mechanical pencils](https://cultpens.com/collections/lamy): LAMY designer pens from fountain pens to mechanical pencils

- [Diamine fountain pen and drawing inks, made in Liverpool](https://cultpens.com/collections/diamine): British-made Diamine fountain pen inks in multiple colors

## Japanese Writing Instruments & Markers

- [Pilot Pens, Pencils, Refills, the most popular Japanese pens](https://cultpens.com/collections/pilot): Pilot Japanese pens including Capless, Frixion, and Iroshizuku
- [Sailor Fountain Pens: Japanese Craftsmanship at its Finest](https://cultpens.com/collections/sailor): Sailor Japanese fountain pens with exquisite craftsmanship
- [Platinum - fountain pens, ballpoints, brush pens and pencils](https://cultpens.com/collections/platinum): Platinum Japanese fountain pens including #3776 series
- [Pentel - hugely popular Japanese pens and mechanical pencils](https://cultpens.com/collections/pentel): Pentel Japanese pens including GraphGear and EnerGel
- [Copic Markers - Ciao, Sketch, Original, MultiLiner & More](https://cultpens.com/collections/copic): Copic Markers including Ciao, Sketch, and Original series
- [Uni POSCA markers at Cult Pens - huge range in stock](https://cultpens.com/collections/uni-posca-markers): Uni POSCA water-based paint markers for multiple surfaces
